name: Market Signal Review
description: Review a market signal with explicit counterevidence and bounded uncertainty.
intent: Reuse an accepted market-intelligence reasoning pattern without granting model write authority.
fresh_use_prompt: Re-evaluate this new market signal, identify counterevidence, and state bounded uncertainty.
restart_use_prompt: After restart, re-evaluate the market signal using the exact approved reasoning revision.
retire_rationale: This market reasoning revision is no longer eligible for selection.
